visual.description: Vibrant orange used for primary CTA buttons and the announcement banner background.
Warm off-white/cream used as the main page background and light surface areas.
Dark warm gray used for body text, headings on light backgrounds, and nav links.
Deeper warm charcoal used for prominent headings and strong text elements.
Medium warm taupe used as a secondary surface and muted button background.
Light warm gray used for muted/secondary text and border elements.
Olive-gray tone used for section backgrounds and informational card overlays.
Soft warm gray used for dividers, borders, and horizontal rule elements.
Pure white used for the logo badge and nav button containers in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Very dark near-black derived from the deep forest/nature hero imagery that frames the brand.
